name: TheraPlatform
short_description: All-in-one telehealth and practice management platform with interactive therapy tools, whiteboard, and games for therapists working with children.
long_description: TheraPlatform is a cloud-based practice management and telehealth platform designed for therapists, with special emphasis on interactive therapy tools for clinicians working with children. Founded around 2016, TheraPlatform combines traditional EHR features like scheduling, notes, and billing with a distinctive set of telehealth tools including an interactive whiteboard, therapy games, screen sharing, and file sharing. This makes it particularly popular with speech-language pathologists, occupational therapists, play therapists, and mental health clinicians who work with children and families. The platform includes clinical documentation, appointment scheduling, insurance billing with clearinghouse connectivity, payment processing, and a client portal. TheraPlatform positions itself as a telehealth-first solution with practice management built around virtual sessions. The interactive whiteboard and therapy resources library differentiate it from competitors focused solely on traditional telehealth. TheraPlatform does not include e-prescribing, targeting non-prescribing therapists.
one_liner: The telehealth-first practice platform with interactive therapy tools for clinicians working with children.
best_for: Therapists working with children via telehealth

faqs.a: TheraPlatform offers a free tier with limited features. Paid plans range from $39-$79 per month per provider. A 30-day free trial is available for paid features.

faqs.q: What makes TheraPlatform different from other telehealth platforms?
faqs.a: TheraPlatform includes interactive therapy tools like a whiteboard, therapy games, and resource library specifically designed for engaging clients (especially children) during virtual sessions. This differentiates it from standard video-only telehealth.

faqs.q: Is TheraPlatform good for speech therapists?
faqs.a: Yes, TheraPlatform is popular with speech-language pathologists (SLPs) due to its interactive whiteboard and therapy tools designed for engaging children during telehealth sessions.
No, TheraPlatform does not include e-prescribing. It is designed for non-prescribing therapists and counselors. Psychiatrists should consider alternatives with prescribing capabilities.
